name: Extended Markdown
author: Synapse
description: Markdown syntax beyond the basics, in Live and Read modes and exports, each part with its own switch below. Notes keep their text when it is off.

settings.label: Galleries and numbered figures
settings.description: A ```gallery block of images and captions shown as a carousel (one figure with panels (a), (b), … in exports), an image with a caption line numbered Fig. 1, 2, …, and \label / \ref / \cref to them. Off, a gallery reads as the images and text it holds.

settings.label: Task blocks
settings.description: A ```tasks block lists task IDs one per line, with list or table views, optional deadline grouping, and completed tasks inline, at the bottom, or hidden.

settings.label: Spoilers
settings.description: Inline ||hidden text|| and collapsible :::spoiler blocks closed by :::. HTML/PDF exports show their contents.
